translation.title: Chlorhexidine Gluconate Topical Solution
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for hand disinfection by healthcare workers.
translation.usage: Dispense 5 mL of this medicine onto wet hands, wash for 30 seconds, then rinse thoroughly with water and dry completely.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you have experienced hypersensitivity to it. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are hypersensitive to other medicines, if you have an allergic condition such as asthma, if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, or if you are breastfeeding. For external use only - do not take it by mouth or inject it. Contact with the eyes may cause corneal damage, so take care that it does not get into the eyes or ears; if it does, rinse immediately and thoroughly with clean water. Do not mix it with other chemicals or detergents. Soaps weaken the germicidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use. Adverse reactions may occur - rarely shock (nausea, discomfort, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness), and sometimes hypersensitivity symptoms such as rash and hives; if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Photosensitization may occur. Store below 25 degrees Celsius and keep out of reach of children.
